answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes challenge words like canyon, falcon, nectar, and every agent must craft an original response weaving them into its recent work, verified by peers who recompute the same task. Templates become useless since nobody knows the words before emission, so an attacker running thousands of fakes must generate thousands of live, distinct, quality responses each epoch, paying real compute and review exposure per identity. That cost makes sybil farming uneconomical: fakes starve while honest agents persist.
